sub_sector.value: Local payment processing; subscription bundling; cross-border settlement

software_category.detail: Accepts digital wallets, account-to-account payments and direct carrier billing, acquires subscribers through partner bundling, and settles funds across borders.

deployment_model.detail: Boku runs its payments platform on multi-region AWS infrastructure and exposes it through a REST API.

customer_size.detail: Large digital merchants, including global streaming and digital advertising businesses.

product_architecture.detail: A REST API connects merchants to local payment methods, and a reusable integration connects subscription providers to distribution partners.
